summary_md:
# 93. Att gå all in kort på en cyberattack

**Feed**: veckans-trade  
**Published**: 2026-10-21  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

In this episode of Veckans Trade, a solo host who trades as a contrarian makes fun of momentum fund managers (Jonas Olavi/Alpcot rates ASML, TSMC and Nvidia '10 buy' and property '0'), says he has built a portfolio of Swedish property stocks to hold, and says he would never subscribe to the Prisjakt IPO. He walks through his trades during the CoreWeave/AI selloff: he went all-in short Yubico, bought the dips in Atlas Copco, ABB and Sivers, and bought Millicom after the Starlink scare. He also covers earnings season: Hacksaw's profit warning (he shorted it and lost), a strong positive profit alert from MSAB and a positive profit alert from MilDef.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🔴 YUBICO — Yubico | **SELL** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 70%

Host went all-in short when Yubico held flat during the US AI/cyber selloff, then covered at a profit.

#### Reasoning

Host's own trade. After a 6% jump on target-price raises, Yubico lagged the US cyber ETF and AI names, which were falling more than 10%. He shorted it for a catch-up move and expects it to keep trading in tandem with US moves. It was a short-term tactical trade that is now covered.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the US AI/cyber selloff reverses
- if analyst upgrades keep supporting the stock

> *"Jag var i princip först all in kort, Yubico"*

---

### 🟢 ABB — ABB | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Fell from 1000 to 850 SEK in five days on an in-line report; host bought the intraday dip.

#### Reasoning

Host's view: the report was in line, ABB has operational tailwind and doesn't need the AI story. Selling was driven by broad US AI weakness, not fundamentals. This is a reactive dip trade, possibly exited quickly.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the US AI selloff deepens
- if the fundamentals actually deteriorate

> *"ABB har gått från 1000 till 850 spänn på fem handelsdagar"*

---

### 🟢 ATCO-A — Atlas Copco | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Host bought the dip, saying it was unfairly punished in the CoreWeave selloff.

#### Reasoning

Host thinks Atlas Copco has little to do with CoreWeave, so the AI-driven drop overshot. It is a small opportunistic trade; he admits he doesn't really know why he did it.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI capex fears spread to industrials

> *"Jag köpte dippen i Atlas Copco. Vet inte varför."*

---

### 🟢 SIVE — Sivers Semiconductors | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Down about 16%; host bought it because it trades with a lag to US peers (Lumentum, Marvell), and the trade went well.

#### Reasoning

Host noted that Sivers reacts to US photonics moves with a lag, so it can be traded on that delay. He bought the capitulation and it paid off. This is a short-term reactive trade.

#### Sell Triggers

- if US photonics peers keep falling

> *"Köpte till och med svenska Sivers, underbara Sivers, var ner nästan 16 procent."*

---

### 🟢 TIGO — Millicom | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Fell from above $100 to below $80 on the Starlink threat; host bought a small position.

#### Reasoning

Host doesn't believe Starlink will take over Latin American telecom in the near term. LatAm telecom is a slow industry, the last report was very strong, and the sector sold off on Musk's hype. It's a contrarian position, not a deep analysis.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Starlink actually wins LatAm subscribers
- if the next report disappoints

> *"Så jag har köpt lite aktier under 80 dollar."*

---

### ⛔ PRISJAKT — Prisjakt | **AVOID** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 90%

IPO repriced from about 3bn to 675m SEK; host says the price-comparison model will die with AI agents and the Google suit is a binary bet.

#### Reasoning

Host says the IPO is set up to fool retail savers. AI agents make price comparison obsolete within about 5 years, the 21.4bn Google lawsuit is a lottery ticket, and slashing the IPO price doesn't change the business. He will never subscribe or buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Google lawsuit is won

> *"Jag personligen kommer aldrig att teckna prisjakt"*

---

### 🟠 MSAB-B — MSAB | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Second positive profit alert in a row, profit +57%; no headwinds, new CEO, strong owners. Host sold into the spike.

#### Reasoning

MSAB is a forensic-software company with about 94% gross margin that could be classed as cybersecurity. It has new growth legs and strong owners, and could keep grinding higher as funds rotate away from tired winners. Host sold most of his shares beforehand and the rest at +12%, but remains constructive.

#### Sell Triggers

- if growth stalls
- if forensic-tool demand from authorities weakens

> *"det här kan ju lätt vara en aktie som bara fortsätter gneta på"*

---

### ⛔ HACK — Hacksaw | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Profit warning: growth more than halved and the stock fell about 30%. Few buyers, a crowded trade, and iGaming is hard to understand.

#### Reasoning

Host says there is little institutional capital in the stock and it was a crowded favourite. He also finds iGaming opaque. He shorted it, lost on the cover, and sees most owners giving up.

#### Sell Triggers

- if growth re-accelerates

> *"tillväxten mer än halverades och aktien är ner 30%"*

---

### 🟠 MILDEF — MilDef | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Positive profit alert, good execution, cheaper than Invisio, no slowdown in orders.

#### Reasoning

Host treats defence as a theme. MilDef executes well operationally and is valued more cheaply than Invisio. A possible end to the war doesn't belong in the analysis.

#### Sell Triggers

- if defence orders slow

> *"Man måste ändå ge dem att de gör något jätterätt operationellt."*

---

### 🟢 PROPERTY — Swedish property stocks (basket) | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 75%

Host built a portfolio of property stocks as a contrarian bet against managers who rate property 0 and AI '10 buy'.

#### Reasoning

Host believes the expected return of Swedish property companies beats the AI high-flyers. Managers hate the sector, and prefs yield too little when rates rise. He did not name the specific stocks.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the 10-year yield keeps rising sharply
- if the rental market weakens further

> *"Jag har köpt en portfölj av fastighetsbolag som jag kommer hårdla över allting."*

---
